description: Pilot private-input predicate. Checks that privately held reserve amounts, 16 fixed slots each tagged with one of the eight reserve categories the GENIUS Act lists in section 4(a)(1)(A)(i) to (viii), add up to at least a privately held amount of payment stablecoins outstanding, and publishes only a yes/no verdict. Carries an OCG Standard section 25 ocg-private-input@1 declaration: the reserves and the outstanding amount are each committed under sha256-salted@1 with their own independent salt, in policy_parameters.reserves_commitment and policy_parameters.outstanding_commitment, so the outstanding figure can be opened to an auditor without opening the reserves. Integer arithmetic only; no haircut, because the statute states none. The witness must be exactly 16 slots of 20-digit amounts so its length does not reveal how many reserve lines exist; any other shape is refused and nothing is sealed. It does not show the reserves exist, are unencumbered, are approved where approval is required, or satisfy the section 4(a)(2) no-rehypothecation rule, and it does not replace the monthly report the Act requires. Its use is a coverage statement between monthly reports, or by a party not under that reporting duty. The verdict is public and the inputs are not in the receipt; a receipt made from inputs given to a server was seen by that server, and many yes/no questions about the same figures reveal more than one. Pilot: the node lands with its proof deferred and the in-browser result is a preview, not a receipt.

cited_clause_digest.clause_path: GENIUS Act (Pub. L. 119-27) Sec. 4(a)(1)(A) -- reserves at least 1 to 1 against outstanding payment stablecoins; permitted reserve categories (i) to (viii)

deferred_reason: New gpu:false private-input node, art-809-check-reserves-cover-outstanding-private, authored 2026-11-03. Exec-only measure on the section 25 private-input guest (PRIVATE-PREDICATE-DESIGN-1, prototype of this kernel): MAX 9,106,901 user_cycles over 58 segments, FAST class under the 30M ceiling; proving is the separate PRIVATE-PREDICATE-PROVE-1 row, which needs its SIDEBYSIDE row first (SO #39). Deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md).
